name: Appartement Geisshornblick
beschreibung: The Appartement Geisshornblick in Tannheim blends the charm of a traditional inn with the comfort of holiday apartments. The name of this accommodation reflects its prime location with views of the namesake Geisshorn. The apartments come fully equipped with kitchens, making them ideal for self-catering. The inn’s own restaurant serves regional dishes. Situated at the entrance to the Tannheimer Tal, it serves as a perfect starting point for hiking and ski tours. The Tannheim ski area is just a short walk away.
